title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the Supplementary Punishment May Be Increased after the Criminal Second Instance Judgment Changes the Crime Determined in the First Instance Judgment

articles.content_en:
June 6, 2008
Supreme People's Court
Reply on Whether Supplementary Punishment May Be Imposed After the Second Instance Criminal Judgment Changes the Crime Found in the First Instance Judgment
Fa Shi [2008] No. 8
Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:
Recently, some Higher People's Courts have requested clarification on whether, when the court of second instance adjudicates a criminal case appealed by the defendant, if the judgment of the second instance changes the crime found in the first instance judgment, it may impose additional supplementary punishment or convert a fine into confiscation of property, among other issues. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
According to Article 190 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, when the court of second instance adjudicates a case appealed by the defendant or his legal representative, defender, or close relatives, it shall not aggravate the punishment of the defendant. Therefore, if the court of first instance did not impose supplementary punishment, the court of second instance shall not impose supplementary punishment after changing the crime; if the supplementary punishment originally imposed by the court of first instance is relatively light, the court of second instance shall not change it to a heavier supplementary punishment, nor shall it remand the case to the court of first instance for retrial on the ground of unclear facts or insufficient evidence; if a retrial must be conducted according to law, it shall be carried out through the trial supervision procedure after the judgment or ruling of the second instance takes effect.
This reply is hereby given.
